# CHRONIC MENINGITIS

Subacute meningeal symptoms, including headache, fever, and nausea for 4 weeks
or more. Chronic meningitis is caused by a long list of infectious and
non-infectious etiologies. Treatment is based on etiology and empirical
treatment is not urgent unless tuberculosis is suspected. Consult Infectious
Diseases for more information.
